boundary: Internal engineering facts, DERIVED from code and contracts and regenerated on demand. Never hand-edit. Distinct from config/public-product-facts.json, which is hand-curated public product policy (release version, minimum device, canonical benchmark hardware) validated against project.yml and README. Different provenance and different audience: if a value can be read out of the tree it belongs here; if it is a decision about what we publish it belongs there.
